_: Návrh položky hlasování k reelu Day 16 (přidat do queue.json až po schválení videa; vote se otevře zveřejněním reelu). Účinek od příští bitvy (from = day + 2), 4 dny.

vote.question: Save your wounded, or win the fight?
vote.note: Comment HOSPITAL or TANK under the post. Each side votes for itself; your soldier is your ballot.

options.label: A new hospital dugout, surgeons and stretchers: fewer of your wounded die
options.outcome: The {side} dug a new hospital dugout. Surgeons and stretcher teams came up the line.

options.label: A tank for 4 days: your shooters hit harder, but it draws fire

0.outcome: A Behemoth tank rolled up behind the Hegemony line, guns out. Every shooter near it fires harder, and every enemy gun now looks for it.

1.outcome: A Tortoise tank clanked up behind the Concord line, turret turning. Every shooter near it fires harder, and every enemy gun now looks for it.
